## Methods

### ListBootEntries

:material-waves: streaming (requires `more`)

Enumerates boot entries. Method call must be called with 'more' flag set. Each response returns one entry. If no entries are defined returns the NoSuchBootEntry error.

```go
func (c *Client) ListBootEntries(ctx context.Context) iter.Seq2[*ListBootEntriesOut, error]
```

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entry` | `BootEntry` | A boot menu entry structure |

### SetRebootToFirmware

Sets the reboot-to-firmware-UI flag of the firmware, if this concept exists. Returns the RebootToFirmwareNotSupported error if not.

```go
func (c *Client) SetRebootToFirmware(ctx context.Context, in SetRebootToFirmwareIn) error
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `bool` | The new value of the reboot-to-firmware-UI flag |

### GetRebootToFirmware

Gets the current state of the reboot-to-firmware-UI flag of the firmware, if this concept exists. Returns the RebootToFirmwareNotSupported error if not.

```go
func (c *Client) GetRebootToFirmware(ctx context.Context) (*GetRebootToFirmwareOut, error)
```

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `bool` | The current state of the reboot-to-firmware-UI flag |

### Install

:material-new-box: since v260 · :material-file-swap: passes file descriptors

Install the boot loader on the ESP.

```go
func (c *Client) Install(ctx context.Context, in InstallIn) error
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `operation` | `Operation` | Operation, either 'new' or 'update' |
| `graceful` | `?bool` | If true, continue on various failures |
| `rootFileDescriptor` | `?int` | Index into array of file descriptors passed along with this message, pointing to file descriptor to root file system to operate on |
| `rootDirectory` | `?string` | Root directory to operate relative to. If both this and rootFileDescriptor is specified, this is purely informational. If only this is specified, it is what will be used. |
| `bootEntryTokenType` | `?BootEntryTokenType` | Selects how to identify boot entries |
| `touchVariables` | `?bool` | If true the boot loader will be registered in an EFI boot entry via EFI variables, otherwise this is omitted |

## Types

### BootEntryType

The type of a boot entry

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `type1` | Boot Loader Specification Type #1 entries (.conf files) |
| `type2` | Boot Loader Specification Type #2 entries (UKIs) |
| `loader` | Additional entries reported by boot loader |
| `auto` | Automatically generated entries |

### BootEntrySource

The source of a boot entry

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `esp` | Boot entry found in EFI system partition (ESP) |
| `xbootldr` | Boot entry found in XBOOTLDR partition |

### Operation

The operation to execute

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `new` | Install the boot loader afresh, creating everything it needs |
| `update` | Just update existing boot loader binaries |

### BootEntryTokenType

The boot entry token type to use.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `machine_id` | Pick identifiers for type #1 boot entries based on /etc/machine-id |
| `os_image_id` | Pick identifiers for type #1 boot entries based on the IMAGE_ID= field from /etc/os-release |
| `os_id` | Pick identifiers for type #1 boot entries based on the ID= field from /etc/os-release |
| `literal` | Pick identifiers for type #1 boot entries based on a manually chosen string |
| `auto` | Choose automatically how to pick identifiers for type #1 boot entries |

### BootEntryAddon

A structure encapsulating an addon of a boot entry

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globalAddon` | `?string` | The location of the global addon. |
| `localAddon` | `?string` | The location of the local addon. |
| `options` | `string` | The command line options by the addon. |

### BootEntry

A structure encapsulating a boot entry

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `BootEntryType` |  |
| `source` | `BootEntrySource` | The source of the entry |
| `id` | `?string` | The string identifier of the entry |
| `path` | `?string` | Path to the primary definition file for the entry |
| `root` | `?string` | Directory path of the file system root the entry was found on |
| `title` | `?string` | The entry's title string |
| `showTitle` | `?string` | The possibly mangled/augmented title to show for the entry |
| `sortKey` | `?string` | An explicitly configured sorting key for the enry |
| `version` | `?string` | The version of the entry |
| `machineId` | `?string` | Machine ID of the OS installation belonging to the entry, if known |
| `architecture` | `?string` | EFI architecture name for this entry |
| `options` | `?string` | Command line options to pass to the invoked kernel or EFI binary |
| `linux` | `?string` | Path to the Linux kernel to invoke, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file |
| `efi` | `?string` | Path to the EFI binary to invoke, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file |
| `uki` | `?string` | Path to an UKI EFI binary to invoke, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file |
| `profile` | `?int` | An UKI profile index to invoke. If not specified defaults to the first profile. |
| `initrd` | `?[]string` | Path to the initrd image to pass to the invoked kernel, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file |
| `devicetree` | `?string` | Devicetree file to pass to the invoked kernel, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file |
| `devicetreeOverlay` | `?[]string` | Devicetree overlay file to pass to the invoked kernel, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file |
| `isReported` | `bool` | Indicates whether the boot loader reported this entry on the current boot |
| `triesLeft` | `?int` | Indicates the number of tries left for this boot entry before it is assumed to be not working. |
| `triesDone` | `?int` | Indicates the number of unsuccessful tries already made for this boot entry. |
| `isDefault` | `?bool` | Indicates whether this entry is the default entry. |
| `isSelected` | `?bool` | Indicates whether this entry has been booted. |
| `addons` | `?[]BootEntryAddon` | Addon images of the entry. |
| `cmdline` | `?string` | Command line options of the entry. |

## Errors

| Error | Go type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `RebootToFirmwareNotSupported` | `RebootToFirmwareNotSupportedError` | SetRebootToFirmware() and GetRebootToFirmware() return this if the firmware does not actually support the reboot-to-firmware-UI concept. |
| `NoSuchBootEntry` | `NoSuchBootEntryError` | No boot entry defined. |
| `NoESPFound` | `NoESPFoundError` | No EFI System Partition (ESP) found. |
| `BootEntryTokenUnavailable` | `BootEntryTokenUnavailableError` | The select boot entry token could not be determined. |
